content: A tenant failed to pay rent for three consecutive months in 2025 in Mumbai. Under the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999, what are the mandatory notice requirements before initiating eviction proceedings?

Under Section 119 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999, the landlord must give the tenant a written notice demanding payment of rent due, or an order to vacate, within 30 days of the first default, and a further 30-day notice for the second default. [Source: Section 119, Maharashtra Rent Control Act 1999]
Explain the ratio decidendi in the Supreme Court case 'Sharma vs. State of Delhi (2022) 4 SCC 891' regarding anticipatory bail in white-collar crimes.

The ratio decidendi states that anticipatory bail is not a right but a privilege, and it cannot be guaranteed to a person accused of a bailable offence, nor can it be used as a tool to secure bail in serious crimes like fraud or embezzlement. [Source: Section 482, BNSS 2023]
